mappings.note: Why 'People of the Ward' sit at the base of the pyramid - power flowing upwards from citizens (CG-SST3) through the urban local structure (LO-271).
Obstacles urban bodies face in fast-growing cities - strained infrastructure, thin finances, weak expertise: entirely about how these bodies function, so LO-271.
A Ward Committee clearing blocked drains before approaching the Corporation: the urban body at work (LO-271) with residents mobilised as participants (CG-SST3).

A Municipal Council raising property tax for parks and waste services after public consultation, with the answer extending to the Madras Corporation's gain of taxing power: the urban body's finances (LO-271) settled through consultation (CG-SST3).
Rural and urban community decision-making compared through Sameer and Anita: the two kinds of local body (LO-271) and how directly people take part in each (CG-SST3).
Why citizen duties matter in a participatory democracy - governance as shared responsibility (CG-SST3) that local bodies depend on (LO-271).
Children being heard in a village but not easily in a city: accessibility of democratic participation (CG-SST3) across rural and urban local bodies (LO-271).
How decentralisation empowers communities and makes governance responsive - the role of government at the local level (LO-269) as a democratic gain (CG-SST3).
